tradeForensics.whatCouldHaveBeenDone: Wait for a 5-minute candle close strictly above the Call Wall before buying CE, reducing false break traps.

tradeForensics.whatCouldHaveBeenDone: Trust the statistical edge; let the algo manage orders strictly to pure spot SL or target.
